title: Adorned with Gold and Serpents
translation: Adorned with gold and great jewels, beautiful with the king of serpents coiled around it, the liṅga that ended Dakṣa's sacrifice: I bow to that liṅga of Sadāśiva.
translation_hi: जो सोने और महामणियों से विभूषित है, सर्पराज से लिपटा हुआ सुशोभित है, और जिसने दक्ष के यज्ञ का विनाश किया, उस सदाशिव लिंग को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।
grammar: Mātrā equivalence: कनकमहा… starts with four light syllables (◡◡◡◡ = 4 mātrās), the same weight as — ◡ ◡. The scanner shows these lines as mātrā-equal.
Dakṣa's yajña: the same story as makha-cchid in Tāṇḍava verse 9.
Refrain: तत्प्रणमामि सदाशिवलिङ्गम् 'I bow to that liṅga of Sadāśiva.'
